primary_task: Fine-tune a model (e.g. SFT of gpt-4.1-mini) on Microsoft Foundry: validate the training data, baseline the base model, submit and monitor the training job.

requirements.name: azure
requirements.evidence: Fine-tune models using SFT (supervised), DPO (preference), or RFT ... `python scripts/submit_training.py --model gpt-4.1-mini --training-file train.jsonl ...` | `scripts/deploy_model.py` | Deploy via ARM REST API |
requirements.basis: lacks: "accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, ...)"

requirements.name: Microsoft Foundry / Azure OpenAI endpoints (*.openai.azure.com, *.cognitiveservices.azure.com, management.azure.com)
requirements.evidence: 1. **Always baseline first** — evaluate the base model before fine-tuning ... Submit SFT job | `python scripts/submit_training.py ...`

requirements.name: python with openai SDK
requirements.evidence: "API version not supported" | Older `openai` SDK on `/v1/` endpoint | Upgrade to `openai>=1.0`
requirements.basis: tools.bash: "install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, ...)"

requirements.name: skill scripts (scripts/submit_training.py, scripts/validate/validate_sft.py, ...)
requirements.basis: tools.skill: "load an installed Claude Code skill"; the manifest does not say whether the bundled scripts are installed.

blocking: egress:Microsoft Foundry / Azure OpenAI endpoints (*.openai.azure.com, *.cognitiveservices.azure.com, management.azure.com)
notes: Local data validation alone could run, but the primary task (training job on Foundry, and the mandatory base-model baseline) requires Azure access. If the request were only 'prepare/validate my training data', it would be ACHIEVABLE (scripts presence unknown).
